records.jp: 戻ってきた……
records.en_original: We made it back...
records.en_auxiliary: We made it back...
records.en: We made it back...

records.jp: みんなは……<CR>！
records.en_original: Is everyone...?　<CR>!
records.en_auxiliary: What about everyone else?
records.en: Everyone...<CR>!

records.jp: なるほど……そういうことか
records.en_original: I get it... So that's how it is.
records.en_auxiliary: I get it... So that's how it is.
records.en: I get it... So that's how it is.

records.jp: いきなりオーディションなんて言い始めた理由が<CR>やっとわかったわ
records.en_original: I finally understand why you called for an audition out of the blue.
records.en_auxiliary: I finally understand why you called for an audition out of the blue.
records.en: Now I finally understand<CR>why you suddenly proposed an audition.

records.jp: 趣味が悪いわね。人の心に土足で踏み込んでくるなんて
records.en_original: That's one awful hobby you have, tromping your way into people's hearts.
records.en_auxiliary: That's one awful hobby you have, tromping your way into people's hearts.
records.en: That's one awful hobby you have, tromping your way into people's hearts.

records.jp: フラグメントのことを理解してる……？
records.en_original: You understand how Fragments work?
records.en_auxiliary: You understand how Fragments work?
records.en: She understands Fragments...?

records.jp: 何度もフラグメントに接触したから<CR>コモンでの記憶が流れてきたのかも……
records.en_original: She might have memories from the Common since we've been in contact with her Fragment multiple times...
records.en_auxiliary: She might have memories from the Common since we've been in contact with her Fragment multiple times...
records.en: Maybe the memories from the Common flowed into her<CR>because we came into contact with her Fragment so many times...

records.jp: ……そこについては、言い訳する気はないよ
records.en_original: ...You're right. I have no excuse for that.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right. I have no excuse for that.
records.en: ...I'm not going to make excuses for that.

records.jp: 私は麻央のことを理解したかったから
records.en_original: I just wanted to understand you better.
records.en_auxiliary: I just wanted to understand you better.
records.en: I just wanted to understand you better.

records.jp: で、どうだった？　理解できた？　馬鹿どもに振り回された<CR>私の思いは
records.en_original: And? Do you understand now? How it feels to be kicked around by those idiots?
records.en_auxiliary: And? Do you understand now? How it feels to be kicked around by those idiots?
records.en: And? Do you understand now?<CR>How it feels to be pushed around by those idiots?

records.jp: あんな連中を野放しにしちゃいけないって、<CR>よく分かったでしょ？
records.en_original: You understand why I can't leave people like that unchecked, don't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You understand why I can't leave people like that unchecked, don't you?
records.en: You understand now<CR>why I can't leave people like that unchecked, don't you?

records.jp: 確かに、麻央が絶望する理由はわかる。<CR>人のことを信じられなくなる気持ちも
records.en_original: I see why you've lost hope in humanity. Why you don't feel like you can trust anybody.
records.en_auxiliary: I see why you've lost hope in humanity. Why you don't feel like you can trust anybody.
records.en: I understand why you despaired, Mao.<CR>I understand why you stopped being able to trust people.

records.jp: でもみんながみんな、悪意だけを持ってるわけじゃない。<CR>善意のほうが強い人だって、いっぱいいる
records.en_original: But not everyone is so malicious. Plenty of people are filled with kindness too.
records.en_auxiliary: But not everyone is so malicious. Plenty of people are filled with kindness, too.
records.en: But not everyone is driven only by malice.<CR>There are plenty of people whose goodwill is stronger.

records.jp: 完璧な善人はいない。でも完全な悪人もいない。<CR>麻央の考え方は一方的すぎる
records.en_original: Nobody's completely good, but nobody's completely bad either. Mao, you're only looking at one side of things.
records.en_auxiliary: Nobody's completely good, but nobody's completely bad either. Mao, you're only looking at one side of things.
records.en: No one is perfectly good, but no one is completely evil either.<CR>Your way of thinking is too one-sided, Mao.

records.jp: だから皆のことを信じろって？<CR>は！　それこそ一方的すぎるでしょ
records.en_original: So, what, are you telling me to go around believing in everyone? Ha! That's equally one-sided, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what, are you telling me to go around believing in everyone? Ha! That's equally one-sided, isn't it?
records.en: So you're telling me to believe in everyone?<CR>Ha! That's just as one-sided, isn't it?

records.jp: 善人が一人でもいたら百万の悪人を信じろっていうの？
records.en_original: Should I believe in a million bad people just for the sake of one good person?
records.en_auxiliary: Should I believe in a million bad people just for the sake of one good person?
records.en: Should I believe in a million bad people just for the sake of one good person?

records.jp: そうは言ってない。<CR>でも麻央は、自分の経験だけで他の人を全部疑えって言ってるよ
records.en_original: I never said that. But you're telling me to be distrustful of everyone based solely on your bad experiences.
records.en_auxiliary: I never said that. But you're telling me to be distrustful of everyone based solely on your bad experiences.
records.en: I never said that.<CR>But you're telling me to distrust everyone based only on your own experiences.

records.jp: 芸能界と学校じゃ、そこにいる人の性格も、考え方も<CR>生き方だって、全然違うかもしれないのに
records.en_original: The girls at this school have different personalities and ways of thinking than the people you've met in the industry.
records.en_auxiliary: The girls at this school have different personalities and ways of thinking than the people you've met in the industry.
records.en: People in show business and people at school may have completely different personalities,<CR>ways of thinking—even ways of life.

records.jp: ……同じよ。誰も彼も、みんな変わらない
records.en_original: ...They're all the same. Whether they're men, women, boys, or girls, they're all the same.
records.en_auxiliary: ...They're all the same. Whether they're men, women, boys, or girls, they're all the same.
records.en: ...They're the same. Everyone is. No one is any different.

records.jp: 私はそんなことないと思ってる
records.en_original: I don't think so.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think so.
records.en: I don't think so.

records.jp: 平行線ね
records.en_original: This isn't going anywhere.
records.en_auxiliary: This isn't going anywhere.
records.en: This isn't going anywhere.

records.jp: うん、平行線だね
records.en_original: You're right, it's not.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right, it's not.
records.en: Yeah. We're at an impasse.

records.jp: で？　どうするつもり？<CR>お互い相容れなくて、歩み寄れなくて、で、次に何をするの？
records.en_original: So? Now what's your plan? We're never going to come to any common ground, so what now?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what's your plan? We're never going to come to any common ground, so what now?
records.en: So? What are you going to do?<CR>We can't accept each other or meet halfway, so what comes next?

records.jp: 分からない。けど、今のあなたを放ってはおけない
records.en_original: I don't know. But I can't leave you like this.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know. But I can't leave you like this.
records.en: I don't know. But I can't leave you like this.

records.jp: このまま麻央がみんなを傷つけ続けるのを<CR>見過ごすつもりはないよ
records.en_original: I won't keep watching you hurt everyone else.
records.en_auxiliary: I won't keep watching you hurt everyone else.
records.en: I won't stand by<CR>while you keep hurting everyone, Mao.

records.jp: ……へえ、ご苦労なことね。<CR>でも人の心配をする前に自分の心配をした方がいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: ...My, how noble of you. But you might want to take care of yourself before you start worrying about others.
records.en_auxiliary: ...My, how noble of you. But you might want to take care of yourself before you start worrying about others.
records.en: ...My, how noble of you.<CR>But perhaps you should worry about yourself before worrying about others.

records.jp: 私の中身を全て知ってしまったあなたに、<CR>このまま平穏な学校生活を送らせると思ってる？
records.en_original: Did you think I'd just let you carry on with your normal life now that you've seen everything inside my heart?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you think I'd just let you carry on with your normal life now that you've seen everything inside my heart?
records.en: Now that you know everything inside me,<CR>do you think I'll let you continue enjoying a peaceful school life?

records.jp: な、何！？
records.en_original: Wh-What!?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what?!
records.en: Wh-What!?

records.jp: これって！　まさか！
records.en_original: Could it be? No way!
records.en_auxiliary: Could it be? No way!
records.en: This is... It can't be!

records.jp: 原種……。こんな時に！
records.en_original: A Sephira... And now, of all times!
records.en_auxiliary: A Sephira... And now, of all times!
records.en: A Sephira... And now, of all times!

records.jp: なに……あれ……
records.en_original: What...is that...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...is that...?
records.en: What...is that...?

records.jp: 危ない！
records.en_original: Watch out!
records.en_auxiliary: Watch out!
records.en: Watch out!

records.jp: っ！
ヒナちゃん！　大丈夫！？
records.en_original: Hina! Are you okay!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina! Are you okay?!
records.en: Hina-chan! Are you okay!?

records.jp: 私は……平気。麻央は？
records.en_original: I'm fine. How's Mao?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm fine. How about you, Mao?
records.en: I'm...fine. What about you, Mao?

records.jp: 痛ぅ……なんなのよ、いったい
records.en_original: Oww... What the hell is that?
records.en_auxiliary: Oww... What the hell is that?
records.en: Oww... What the hell is that?

records.jp: 原種がいるのに動けてる？　指輪もつけてないのに<CR>フラグメント単体の力？　信じられない
records.en_original: You're acting normally around a Sephira? You don't even have a ring! Could it be due to the power of your Fragment?
records.en_auxiliary: You're able to move even with a Sephira around? You don't even have a ring! Could it be due to the power of your Fragment?
records.en: She can move even with a Sephira nearby? Without a ring?<CR>Is that the power of her Fragment alone? Unbelievable.

records.jp: 何……あいつ、いつもと感じが違う
records.en_original: Wait... There's something different about this one.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait... There's something different about this one.
records.en: What...? It feels different from the others.

records.jp: こっちに来る！　早く迎え撃たないと！
records.en_original: It's coming this way! We need to fight it off, and fast!
records.en_auxiliary: It's coming this way! We need to fight it off, and fast!
records.en: It's coming this way! We have to intercept it quickly!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Ready, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: Ready, Hina?
records.en: Hina-chan!

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Ready.
records.en_auxiliary: Ready.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: 白井……あなた、あんなの相手にいったいどうする気なの？
records.en_original: Shirai... What do you think you can do against THAT thing?
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai... What do you think you can do against that thing?
records.en: Shirai... What do you think you can do against THAT thing?

records.jp: 説明はあと、ここは私達に任せて<CR>麻央は安全なところに隠れてて
records.en_original: I'll explain everything later, just leave this to us. You need to go hide somewhere safe.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll explain everything later, just leave this to us. You need to go hide somewhere safe.
records.en: I'll explain later. Leave this to us.<CR>Mao, hide somewhere safe.
